entries.source: The edge-tts client used here has no invoice and no Microsoft price sheet. A $0 figure is not a commercial license.

entries.notes: Published as $15 per 1M characters. Deprecated; shutdown 2027-01-06. Not selected as the default.
Published as $30 per 1M characters. Deprecated; shutdown 2027-01-06.

Official image-generation calculator for GPT-Image-2.5 at 1024x1536 and quality high: 1372 image-output tokens, $0.04116 at $30 per 1M. The rendered calculator default, GPT-Image-2.6 low at 1024x1024, is 823 tokens and $0.02469, which matches the same formula. This cell excludes text input, image input, and partial images. It is an estimate, not a ceiling. Actual tokens come from the response usage object. Cached input rates do not apply to the direct Images API. Text input is $5 per 1M tokens and image input is $8 per 1M tokens.
Audio output tokens are known only after a call. Do not invent them. Deprecated; shutdown 2027-01-06.
API price $0.08 per 1,000 characters. Persian (fa) is on the Eleven v4 language list. Multilingual v2 does not list Persian. No listening test has been run.
The 29-language list does not include Persian. Do not use it for fa-IR.
Standard tier, published equivalent of 1120 image tokens at $30 per 1M. Prompt input tokens are extra and are not included. Not a photograph of a news event.
Published equivalent for a 1K or 2K output image. Prompt tokens are extra.
Imagen 4 endpoints were scheduled to shut down on 2026-08-17. Do not plan new calls on them.
The Cursor image tool returns no model id, seed, or price. A plan that needs a new Cursor image cannot be cleared against the budget.
